source: Congressional Record parliamentary conventions (recognition / yielding / page furniture)
rationale: Floor and Extensions text is dense with procedural furniture a naive n-gram counter reads as 'coordination'. These seed the CREC-lane boilerplate suppression, applied at n-gram time exactly as the press spine suppresses its own boilerplate. Genre-specific: NEVER applied to the press lane.
phrase_seeds: i reserve the balance of my time
suggest the absence of a quorum
procedural_formulas: the committee of the whole house on the state of the union had under consideration the bill
committee of the whole house on the state of the union
the house in committee of the whole
pursuant to the order of the house
mr speaker i yield myself such time as i may consume
note: phrase_seeds/procedural_formulas are lowercased; suppress an ngram that IS a contiguous substring of a procedural_formula OR contains a phrase_seed. header_patterns strip Record page furniture pre-tokenization. bill_title_seeds flag legislative-title language (the nomenclature-segregation problem) — a coordination metric on CREC must strip these, else bill titles read as message coordination.
amend_policy: extend during D1 with dated amendments in docs/15 §9 only

amendments.reason: the real congress-107 Extensions ledger's top phrases were dominated by the Committee-of-the-Whole procedural formula + 'to provide for … and for other purposes' bill-title language (R1's 'weak carrier' confirmed). Added procedural_formulas + bill_title_seeds. This is a START — the full CREC coordination-boilerplate layer (with a kill-fixture) is queued for the crec-lane SD.* hypotheses (docs/15 D4), not yet complete.

built pipeline/deep/crec_boilerplate.py + tests/test_deep_crec_boilerplate.py (kill-fixture, marquee: procedural convergence != message coordination). Design = 3 precise rules: (1) ngram is a contiguous sub-run of a procedural_formula UNLESS whitelisted (protected_phrases guards the only real phrase embedded in the formulas — 'state of the union'/the SOTU); (2) ngram CONTAINS a phrase_seed (recognition/yielding/'committee of the whole'/'under consideration'); (3) ngram CONTAINS bill_title_seed language. Added 'committee of the whole'+'under consideration' seeds + protected_phrases; dropped the earlier procedural_anchors approach (it let procedural connective-tissue fragments leak). Validated on real 107: all Committee-of-the-Whole procedural furniture removed. KNOWN RESIDUAL (documented boundary): mid-clause fragments of a single inserted BILL PURPOSE clause still leak (e.g. the Energy bill's 'the energy supply for the american people') — full inserted-bill-text / bill-title suppression is the SEPARATE nomenclature-segregation item (needs the congress.gov bill corpus); and sub-gram redundancy is handled by the near-dup collapse layer, not here.
